visualScope: Einsiedeln Abbey in Schwyz with the twin copper-domed towers, curved west front, tiled church and pavilion roofs, and four open courts.
limitations: The abbey footprint, tower centers and four courtyards use attributed PMTiles. Roof pitches, facade opening rhythm, statuary and clock details use ordinary exterior pictures.
The separate stables, fountain, crescent arcades, gardens and paths stay in their original viewer layers. The church and monastery interiors are outside this exterior model.
